accounts.name: admin
accounts.how: any request to baseUrl acts as admin@localhost, an administrator holding a danger-mode session; no headers or sign-in

accounts.name: alice.operator
accounts.how: info.headerAuthUrl with headers Tailscale-User-Login: alice.operator@example.com and Tailscale-User-Name: Alice; on the admin allow-list, so an administrator who starts safety-mode sessions as an operator does (also bob.oncall@ and carol.releases@example.com)

accounts.name: dave.viewer
accounts.how: info.headerAuthUrl with headers Tailscale-User-Login: dave.viewer@example.com and Tailscale-User-Name: Dave; any login off the allow-list is a signed-in non-administrator

accounts.name: suva-facility-device
accounts.how: the device API under baseUrl/public, with the header in info.deviceCertificateHeader; it is device info.deviceId, the machine-role device behind the Suva Facility application
